plan: Add a new Discover feature (Compose screen + ViewModel + mock paginated use case) mirroring the existing Home MVI pattern, plus a bottom-nav scaffold so users can reach it, fixing the missing/empty Discover experience.
steps: Add domain model: create data/model/Paper.kt (id, title, authors, field/category) and a ScientificField list/enum (Biology, Physics, CS, etc.) to back the field tag and category filter.

Create domain/usecase/GetDiscoverFeedUseCase.kt returning a page of mock Paper items given a page index and optional category, mirroring GetFeedUseCase (hardcoded mock data, client-side filtering, finite pages so pagination terminates).
Create discover/DiscoverUiState.kt as a sealed interface: Loading, Success(papers, selectedCategory, isPaginating, endReached), Error, Empty (empty state for no content).

Create discover/DiscoverViewModel.kt exposing StateFlow<DiscoverUiState>; load first page on init, append on LoadNextPage, re-query and reset paging on SelectCategory (client-side filter), emit Empty when no papers, Error on failure.

Create discover/DiscoverScreen.kt: a category filter chip row, a LazyColumn of paper cards (title, authors, field tag), bottom-reached detection that dispatches LoadNextPage, and Loading/Empty/Error rendering; add testTags (discoverFeed, paperCard, paperTitle, fieldTag, errorView) to support UI tests.
Update MainActivity.kt to host a simple bottom navigation (Home + Discover) so the Discover tab is reachable; tag the Discover nav item (nav_discover).

Add app/src/test/java/.../discover/DiscoverViewModelTest.kt covering initial load, category filtering, pagination append, and empty state, following HomeViewModelTest's StandardTestDispatcher pattern.

Add app/src/androidTest/java/.../discover/DiscoverHappyPathTest.kt as a Compose UI test (createAndroidComposeRule + onNodeWithTag) mirroring the ticket's happy paths, since the View/Espresso/RecyclerView IDs in the ticket do not exist in this Compose app.
